items.text: Tattoo painting precision improved with brush size limits, zoom scaling clamps, and UV smoothing.
Two‑layer tattoo system added, allowing base and editing layers with merging, fade handling, and server‑side syncing for multiplayer tattoo chairs.
UZI 9mm now has separate ADS and recoil settings depending on whether the stock is deployed, changing handling and accuracy.
Handmade SMG damage increased from 20 to 21.
Far‑range shot and shell replay issues fixed, improving hit reliability at distance.
Magazine attachment corrected for SpaceLR and M15 guns so magazines no longer stick to the bone.
Engine prefill slots rounded up; a 5‑slot engine now starts with 3 prefilled slots instead of 2.
Map markers can now be dragged with the middle mouse button on the map screen.
Turret network traffic reduced, decreasing outbound data by ~105 KB/s per 122‑player server, improving overall server bandwidth and latency.
Snowmobile wheels no longer jitter at standstill, providing smoother vehicle handling and more stable control.

items.text: Dung boost now applies continuously while an animal eats from the trough, and booster items are prioritized over other food.
Hardcore upkeep rates for bases larger than 65 blocks are increased (0.1/0.15/0.25/0.4), while smaller bases remain unchanged.
Triangle spiral stairs now include an upkeep component, affecting maintenance costs.
Seasonal dungeons and Halloween NPCs no longer spawn inside player-built private areas or safezones, reducing unwanted encounters.
Event candy items (Halloween, Easter) are cleared on server restart, and food placed in the workbench recycle bin upgrade no longer spoils, preventing leftover loot waste.
Halloween DLC items are fixed: lights are craftable with correct stack size and cost, and the alien suit correctly blocks the torso.
Patrol torpedo boats now stay engaged with targets above sea level and hidden player ranking prioritizes visible players; boat privilege regression with cache usage is resolved.
First‑person laser weapons work correctly again, and explosives attached to solar panels now scale properly.

Gamepad support expanded with missing type definitions, stick input is ignored when another device is active, and duck‑latching logic is isolated to gamepads, fixing stick‑drift and escape‑menu input issues.
First‑person weapon effects no longer spawn then hide, cutting a small delay and making AK fire feel snappier.
AK muzzle flash now appears instantly, fixing a previous lag caused by particle mesh lookups.
Inventory rebuild after each shot runs only when the inventory UI is open, reducing shooting‑related frame spikes.
Mag drop handling unified with the glass‑AK system, ensuring consistent drop behavior across weapons.
Server‑side key‑setting limits raised and a hard cap added, preventing crashes from exceeding Steam key quotas.
Main menu rendering issue fixed, eliminating occasional blank screens when launching the game.
Death screen now correctly shows thrown weapons, fixing missing icons after a kill.
Sheep and cow interactions receive longer gestures, added foot‑stomp and head‑shake sounds, and better player‑facing behavior.

2026-10-12.summary:
### Animal & Farming
- Dung boost now applies continuously while an animal eats from the trough, and booster items are prioritized over other food.

### Hardcore & Building Upkeep
- Hardcore upkeep rates for bases larger than 65 blocks are increased (0.1/0.15/0.25/0.4), while smaller bases remain unchanged.
- Triangle spiral stairs now include an upkeep component, affecting maintenance costs.

### Seasonal Events & Items
- Seasonal dungeons and Halloween NPCs no longer spawn inside player-built private areas or safezones, reducing unwanted encounters.
- Event candy items (Halloween, Easter) are cleared on server restart, and food placed in the workbench recycle bin upgrade no longer spoils, preventing leftover loot waste.
- Halloween DLC items are fixed: lights are craftable with correct stack size and cost, and the alien suit correctly blocks the torso.

### Combat & Boats
- Patrol torpedo boats now stay engaged with targets above sea level and hidden player ranking prioritizes visible players; boat privilege regression with cache usage is resolved.
- First‑person laser weapons work correctly again, and explosives attached to solar panels now scale properly.

### Input & Gamepad
- Gamepad support expanded with missing type definitions, stick input is ignored when another device is active, and duck‑latching logic is isolated to gamepads, fixing stick‑drift and escape‑menu input issues.

### Combat & Weapon Performance
- First‑person weapon effects no longer spawn then hide, cutting a small delay and making AK fire feel snappier.
- AK muzzle flash now appears instantly, fixing a previous lag caused by particle mesh lookups.
- Inventory rebuild after each shot runs only when the inventory UI is open, reducing shooting‑related frame spikes.
- Mag drop handling unified with the glass‑AK system, ensuring consistent drop behavior across weapons.

### Stability
- Server‑side key‑setting limits raised and a hard cap added, preventing crashes from exceeding Steam key quotas.

### UI & Menu
- Main menu rendering issue fixed, eliminating occasional blank screens when launching the game.
- Death screen now correctly shows thrown weapons, fixing missing icons after a kill.

### Animal Interaction
- Sheep and cow interactions receive longer gestures, added foot‑stomp and head‑shake sounds, and better player‑facing behavior.

items.text: Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.
Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.
Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.
Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.
Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

2026-10-11.summary:
### Structures
- Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.

### Cosmetics

### Vehicles & Mounts
- Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.

### Livestock & Farming
- Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
- Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.
